_meta.description: Historical CI failure patterns derived from offline evaluation runs. Maps source areas to jobs/tests that historically fail when those areas change. Used by the critic agent to identify gaps in test selections.
_meta.how_to_use: Given a PR's changed files, look up each source area in 'by_source_area'. The 'frequently_failing_jobs' list tells you which CI jobs historically fail for that area — check whether the primary selector covered them. Use 'by_job' to ask the reverse question: given a known failing job type, what source areas usually caused it?
